newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Andersen takes over reins at Liberty Life.
newsitem.headline: Andersen takes over reins at Liberty Life.

text.p: South Africa's Liberty Life Group said on Wednesday that Roy Andersen would take over full executive responsibility for the group with immediate effect.
Andersen, formerly executive president of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, joined the life assurance group as chief executive designate on April 1.
Outgoing chief executive Donald Gordon will stay on as chairman of Liberty Life and all the listed companies within the group.
"Close collaboration and consultation between Mr Gordon and Mr Andersen will continue with regard to the strategic direction of the group," the company announced at its annual meeting.

The responsibility for UK operations will, at this stage, remain with Gordon to whom David Fischel, managing director of Liberty International Holdings Plc, and Douglas Leslie, managing director of Capital Shopping Centres Plc, will continue to report.
